scope: Synthetic upstream feature-projection semantics only; no biological sequences, labels, fitting, parameter search or host prediction
execution: Extract three unchanged function AST nodes; supply their declared dependencies; do not import or execute other upstream code
threshold_rationale: Deliberately separates one-of-two from one-of-one arithmetic in a synthetic contract probe; not a selected biological inference threshold
feature: One merged feature with two distinct family/k-mer members: alpha/AAAAA and beta/CCCCC
cases: both families assigned, both k-mers present
only alpha assigned, its k-mer present
record: Record actual upstream rows and values, including omitted genomes; compare only with an explicitly different fixed-vocabulary denominator illustration
decision_boundary: Do not call global OR projection or a newly implemented family-aware projection equivalent to upstream. Any later adaptation must freeze denominator, unmatched-genome, residue, assignment and feature-order rules before biological execution.
